title: FUTO Microgrants
description: FUTO's one-time microgrants of $1,000 to $5,000 for small or early-stage open source software projects and the people building them. Applications are open and go by email; FUTO has awarded over $60,000 across 52 microgrants. Its larger Legendary Grants are reserved for established open source projects and nonprofits FUTO already trusts.

rules: Applications are open. No deadline and no form are stated: apply by email to grantapps@futo.org.
Microgrants are one-time grants of $1,000 to $5,000 for small or early-stage projects. Many are unsolicited, recommended by FUTO employees who use the projects.

Legendary Grants are large-scale grants for established open source projects and traditional nonprofits with significant impact, generally reserved for established entities FUTO trusts, with an ongoing relationship afterward.
FUTO funds open source software and the people building it to challenge the tech oligopoly; every listed microgrant recipient is an open source project.
